why: The section 2.7 capability vocabulary, read by both implementations:
cli/internal/capability (which parses and enforces grants) and
shared/culprit_model/capabilities.py (which validates what a capture says
it ran under, and what apply-model accepts). A capability one side knows
and the other does not is a grant that means something in the CLI and is
refused - or worse, accepted as free text - by the API.
allowlist: true means the capability is granted per item, as a list, and
`true` is refused for it. No *.write capability exists.
